sections: Project posture kernel and recommendation contracts

repo_truth: The exact base has a private Charter authority writer and private lifecycle store, each still promotion-oriented. The new selector admits only the documented private heterogeneous-head/posture transaction route, after independent admission review. GitNexus FTS is unavailable; exact context and upstream impact are available and recorded.
allowed_scope: Review only the two-file P0 selector subject and the named current source seams needed to verify it.
Report valid P1/P2 against the source selector with exact file/line, violated contract, smallest in-scope remediation, and missing proof.
Report P3/P4 under 09 without widening code, public surfaces, or control-plane scope.
non_goals: Do not edit, format, stage, unstage, commit, create another dispatch, write a global handoff or ledger, or delegate.
Do not implement product source or tests, use a protected checkout, contact a remote, modify a public/schema/dependency/configuration surface, or authorize HCM-5/Flow/adapters.
tasks: Independently determine whether the selector exactly freezes every permitted existing edit symbol, new private module, call path, durable grammar, P1-P4 boundary, risk ceiling, proof command, and final review subject.
Verify that the one-leaf baseline/CAS/deep-diff rule, acyclic record construction, merged canonical head, lifecycle compatibility, and recovery matrix have no public or second-authority escape.
Verify all HIGH/CRITICAL impact warnings are explicit and that the required full compatibility wall is not replaced by focused-only proof.
Return CLEAN only when this P0 subject truthfully admits the complete source route; otherwise return findings first without inventing or broadening authority.
contracts_and_gates: One discovery review for this new implementation outcome; valid P1/P2 require one consolidated remediation and a different-fresh closure; no review follows CLEAN.
A selector CLEAN admits no path outside its exact source ceiling and never waives the inherited ordinary-validator failure or any HCM-3.6 gate.
GitNexus FTS/BM25 unavailability is unavailable, not GREEN. The code-bearing delta later requires staged detection plus an honest compare-to-main artifact.
stop_conditions: Return FINDINGS for valid P1/P2. Return BLOCKED only when a faithful read-only review needs unavailable capability or a scope outside the assigned checkout.
Do not approve a source selector that needs public/schema/dependency/consumer expansion, synthetic promotion, a second current Charter, or unsafe recovery.
